name: Drupal Planet Feeds Block
description: Provides a block that fetches the Drupal Planet RSS feed from drupal.org and renders its latest item titles as links.
project_description: Drupal Planet Feeds Block provides a single block plugin (admin label "Planet Drupal", id drupal_planet_feeds_block) that fetches the official Drupal Planet RSS feed from https://www.drupal.org/planet/rss.xml on every render and lists the latest item titles as links to the original posts, followed by a 'more' link to https://www.drupal.org/planet. Editors configure two per-block-instance options on the block placement form: how many feed items to display (1-30) and which HTML tag wraps each item (chosen from Views' field_rewrite_elements list). The feed URL is hardcoded and not configurable. The module depends on core Views (only to reuse its field_rewrite_elements tag list), ships no settings page, permissions, config schema or Drush commands, and disables render caching so each view refetches the feed.
